name: Reserva
pairings: Roast meats, grilled lamb, duck à l'orange, pork, wild mushrooms, casseroles, Iberian ham, mature cheeses
notes: 100% Tempranillo, hand-harvested (Gimileo & Haro). 18 months in medium-toast American oak, bottled unfiltered. Deep ruby with tawny highlights; black fruit, liquorice, violet, vanilla, sweet spice, toasted bread. Drinking now; will evolve gracefully for 8–12 years.

name: Munfrina
pairings: Charcuterie, pasta with meat sauce, wood-fired pizza, roasted chicken, grilled pork chops
notes: 100% Dolcetto. A vibrant, fruit-forward red with bright acidity, dark cherry notes, and a classic bitter almond finish; typical drinking window used for young Dolcetto.

name: Shiraz
pairings: grilled steaks, barbecue ribs, burgers, pepperoni pizza, mature cheddar
notes: 100% Shiraz. A medium-bodied, approachable wine with ripe plum, blackberry, and subtle spice notes. The drinking window is based on typical ranges for entry-level commercial Australian Shiraz, which is designed for early consumption.
